variants.title: Resume variants
variants.tipBody: The agent writes the best variants. Click for a sentence to say to it.
variants.noMasterBody: Variants are named copies of your master resume, each rewritten with a focus. Jobs pick one. Set the master up first.
variants.emptyBody: Ask the agent to write a variant (a backend-focused one, a concise one-page one, one for a specific posting), or start one from the master. Each job can then be pointed at a variant.
variants.selectOne: Select a variant to preview it.
variants.loadFailed: This variant could not be loaded.
variants.staleBody: The master resume changed after this variant was written. The variant still attaches as-is; ask the agent to refresh it, or edit it here.
variants.noLinkedJobs: No job uses this variant yet. Pick it from the Resume selector in a job's details, or ask the agent to assign it.
variants.nameRequired: Give the variant a name before saving.
variants.nameTaken: A variant called "{{name}}" already exists. Pick another name.

details.title: Details
details.sourceNone: Built by hand or by the agent
details.sourceRemoved: an upload that was since removed
details.name: Name

confirm.deleteMasterMessage: The structured master resume and every variant will be deleted; jobs go back to your original upload. Uploaded files are not affected. This cannot be undone.
confirm.discardMessage: Your edits to "{{name}}" have not been saved. Leave and discard them?
confirm.deleteVariantMessage_one: "{{name}}" will be deleted. {{count}} job uses it and will get the master resume or your original upload instead, according to the fallback setting.
confirm.deleteVariantMessage_other: "{{name}}" will be deleted. {{count}} jobs use it and will get the master resume or your original upload instead, according to the fallback setting.
confirm.deleteVariantMessageNone: "{{name}}" will be deleted. No job uses it.

toast.variantRemoved_one: Variant deleted; {{count}} job goes back to the default resume.
toast.variantRemoved_other: Variant deleted; {{count}} jobs go back to the default resume.
toast.variantUnassigned: This job will use the default resume.

master.emptyBody: The master is your resume as structured content: a header plus any number of sections, each with its own title and layout. The agent can build it from the resume you uploaded, or you can start from scratch.
master.emptyBodyNoUpload: Upload a resume in Settings > Documents so the agent can import it, or start from scratch below.
master.fallback: When a job has no variant assigned, attach
master.fallbackHint: The original upload keeps your own layout; the rendered master uses the selected template so every application looks the same.
master.autoTailorHint: Tells the agent to pick a resume variant for every job it queues (an existing one, or a new one when the posting warrants it) before filling the application. Off means it does so only when you ask.

templates.title: Templates
templates.body: Every resume is rendered through one of these layouts. Pick the default here; a variant can override it.
templates.sampleNote: Shown with sample content until a master resume exists.

classic.name: Classic
classic.description: Single column, serif, centered header. The safe default for any industry.

compact.name: Compact
compact.description: Dense sans-serif with tighter spacing. Fits more on one page.

modern.name: Modern
modern.description: Sans-serif with an accent colour and dates in the left gutter. Still one column, still plain text.

editor.headline: Headline
editor.layoutTextHint: One paragraph: a summary or objective.
editor.layoutEntriesHint: Items with a title, organisation, dates and bullets: jobs, degrees, projects.
editor.layoutGroupsHint: Labelled lists: skills by category, languages.
editor.layoutListHint: A flat list: certifications, awards, interests.
editor.layoutLocked: The layout can only change while the section is empty.
editor.idsNote: Existing sections, entries and groups keep their ids when edited, so variants stay matched to them.

diff.title: Changes against the master
diff.noChanges: This variant is identical to the master.
diff.legend: Green: added. Red, struck through: removed.

prompts.caption: Say this to the agent in the terminal:
prompts.import: Import my uploaded resume into the master resume in Applyer, keeping the wording exactly as written.
prompts.importNoUpload: Help me build my master resume in Applyer from what I tell you about my experience.
prompts.tailor: Tailor a variant of my resume for the {{title}} role at {{company}} and explain what you changed.
prompts.use: Use my "{{name}}" resume variant for the {{title}} role at {{company}}, adjusting it for the posting if needed, and explain what you changed.
prompts.refresh: My master resume changed; refresh my "{{name}}" resume variant against it.
prompts.write: Write a resume variant called "Backend" that leads with my backend work and fits on one page.
prompts.writeHint: Change the name and the focus to what you want. Once it exists, pick it from the Resume selector in a job's details.
